snippet.title: Bubblegum Galaxy - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
We are happy to announce that Bubblegum Galaxy is out now on Steam! The consoles versions will release later along the day. 
Three, almost four years of development come to a conclusion today. We hope you enjoy it and have a nice time, we appreciate it you very much thanks for your support and patience.
